content: Node ZIP extraction for WhatsApp exports: use fflate 0.8.3 streaming Unzip API (memory-safe, 8KB, browser+node reusable). CRITICAL: avoid the buffer-based unzip/unzipSync which loads whole archive into RAM (bad for video-heavy exports). Reject jszip (loads all to memory), yauzl (Node-only, unmaintained, breaks web-reuse), unzipper (Node-only). Isolate behind ChatArchiveReader interface.
